mapper.select: SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API ORDER BY EXTERNAL_API_ID DESC
SELECT EXTERNAL_API_ID, API_NAME, API_URL, HTTP_METHOD, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId}

SELECT PARAM_ID, EXTERNAL_API_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, VALUE_TYPE, PARAM_VALUE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, DESCRIPTION FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_PARAM WHERE EXTERNAL_API_ID = #{externalApiId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, PARAM_ID
